directions.title: Geometry Meets Organic Form
directions.captionSketch: charcoal pencil — the cluster I kept redrawing
directions.captionArtboard: four takes explored on the same artboard
directions.notes:
This direction came out of the pixel/checkerboard doodles scattered across the first sketch page — building the letterform out of a small grid rather than one continuous stroke.

The same Illustrator artboard held several passes at the idea — the icon alone, the icon paired with the wordmark, and two translucent, gradient-blended takes that trade the hard pixel grid for something softer.

The animation tests a "still loading" behavior: pixel cells flicker at slightly different rates, like the mark is assembling itself, while the two bowls breathe gently so it never feels static.

animations.caption: now it's live — real SVG, not a video
